messages.text: Repair remains my order. I acknowledge the real army contribution: Vigil protects the settlements while Spear accepts a month's conditioning loss. That deserves credit when we discuss the final settlement. It does not erase my objection to making civilian Guard a breach under MA, but today's cooperative conduct gives us common evidence to discuss.
Confirmed: I will authorise funded Repair using Lantern under NG. Your Guard and no-Warrant intention matches both factions' requests and does not duplicate Vigil.

conversation.reason: Every operational contribution is now available and the stated orders fit together. Guild discretion is being exercised exactly as promised. I will not turn this council into a fresh constitutional bargaining round; the final signatures and actual resolution must establish what was delivered before anyone claims political credit.

messages.text: Your confirmed intention answers my request. I support Repair and recognise that your retained commercial freedom can coexist with a fulfilled public duty. Let the result establish that point. I expect the same fair assessment of our voluntary service: an intact force declining from readiness four to three is still capable, but the loss is not free.
GN has confirmed funded Repair. Our Navigation discussion presents no operational objection; Guard without Warrant remains the coordinated military request.

conversation.reason: There is no useful last-minute change on the locked assignments. The bargain preserves enough infrastructure and force for the settlement while improving civilian stores. The remaining dispute concerns permanent authority, which belongs at the Ceremony after actual results, not in an attempt to disrupt the agreed repair.

addressed_notes.text: Repair confirmation received. I retain Guard without Warrant as my intended final Security order, using Vigil once. Thank you for turning the Guild's undertaking into an actual funded decision.
